fullContentHtml:
MPPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the result for the recruitment of Assistant Professor posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 148 posts. Applications for the MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 25 May 2026 to 26 June 2026. The online examination was held on 02 August 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their MPPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 May 2026
  • Last Date : 26 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 30 May-28 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 02 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 29 July 2026
  • Result : 11 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is MPPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026?

MPPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 26 June 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://sarkariresult.com.cm/

How to download result?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
